reuse.why: Adds the rule to the existing pre-link guard that all six provider link functions already call before any write.

duplication.why: One query and one throw added once; no per-provider copies.

placement.why: The pre-write guard is the right layer, but a closed-account rule now lives in a function named assertBankAccountNotLinked, which no longer describes everything it checks.

scope.why: A twelve-line guard plus one focused test.

maintainability.why: Simple and centralised; renaming the guard (or splitting it into a sibling assert) would keep its purpose obvious.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by every provider link function before any write.
